title: 第11章 太玄斩道圣典玄级灵兵赤霄刃第12章 师尊您对我好我肯定会对您好啊
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 藏经阁内部，此时已经进了很多人，全都在热火朝天的挑选功法。
不过很多人面对一楼的功法，都是嗤之以鼻，直接朝更高的楼层走去。
在他们看来，越是楼层高，存放的功法就越好。
但苏长歌却反向而驰，他看着那些蜂拥往二楼的人，嘴上扬起一抹诡异笑容，随后便是朝面前一个书架走去。
邋遢老者在传音中告诉他，高楼层确实有好东西，但最好的东西，并不在高楼层，反而在一楼！
那是一本平平无奇的秘籍。
看似如此，但内部却是另有乾坤！
而藏身地点，就在一楼最显眼的书架第七层第六个格子，只要进门，第一眼就能看到！
若是想要，无需弯腰，伸手就可拿到！
苏长歌明白，最危险的地方就是最安全的地方，所以宗主便将这门功法摆放在了众人眼皮子底下！
他摇摇头。
可惜那些人全都是傻子。
也多亏自己面对尊长之时，礼貌问候，最终走了好运！
他走到书架面前，低头看去。
只见这书架一共有十层，而第七层刚好在自己胸膛部位，一眼就能看到，十分显眼！
七层放着很多秘籍，粗略一数，足有二十多本！
而最中间的一本，就是他的目标！
那是一本灰蒙蒙的秘籍，就那样静静躺着，没有任何的气息流出。
看起来很平凡，很普通。
苏长歌却手腕微微颤抖，看了一下左右，确定周围没人之后，猛的出手，将其拿在手中！
入手之后，顿觉不凡！
只是一本书，便有十万斤重量！
这也太恐怖了！
也多亏他现在力量暴涨，要不然恐怕还拿不起这本书！
他匆匆翻开，一股古朴浓郁的道韵顿时扑面而来！
“里面果真另有乾坤！”
低头看去，秘籍上篆刻着密密麻麻的蝌蚪文字，翩若惊鸿，宛若游龙，异光闪烁，散发出深奥玄妙的道理！
顿时间，苏长歌欣喜若狂！
而他也看到了这本秘籍的名字！
这本秘籍外面的封皮上，不过是一本普普通通的——《劈水拳》！
但内部的纸页下方标注页数的地方，却是写着——《太玄斩道圣典》！
“哈哈哈！
这次真的捡了个大便宜！”
content_en:
Inside the Sutra Pavilion, many people had entered at this time, and they were all enthusiastically selecting exercises.
However, many people sneered at the exercises on the first floor and walked directly to higher floors.
In their opinion, the higher the floor, the better the stored skills.
But Su Changge ran in the opposite direction. He looked at the people swarming towards the second floor, raised a strange smile on his lips, and then walked towards the bookshelf in front of him.
The sloppy old man told him in the message that there are indeed good things on the high floors, but the best things are not on the high floors, but on the first floor!
It was an ordinary secret book.
It seems like this, but there is something else going on inside!
The hiding place is on the sixth shelf on the seventh floor of the most conspicuous bookshelf on the first floor. You can see it at first glance as soon as you enter the door!
If you want it, you don’t need to bend down, just reach out and get it!
Su Changge understood that the most dangerous place is the safest place, so the sect leader placed this technique under everyone's nose!
"It's a pity..."
He shook his head.
It's a pity that those people are all fools.
Thanks to my polite greetings when facing my elders, I finally got good luck!
He walked to the bookshelf and looked down.
I saw that this bookshelf has ten floors in total, and the seventh floor is right on my chest. It can be seen at a glance, it is very conspicuous!
There are many secret books on the seventh floor. At a rough count, there are more than twenty books!
And the book in the middle is his goal!
It was a gray secret book, lying quietly like that, without any breath coming out.
It looks ordinary and ordinary.
Su Changge's wrist trembled slightly. After looking around to make sure there was no one around, he suddenly reached out and took it in his hand!
After buying it, I felt extraordinary!
Just one book weighs one hundred thousand kilograms!
This is too scary!
Thanks to his surge in strength now, otherwise he might not be able to pick up this book!
He hurriedly opened it, and a simple and rich Taoist charm suddenly hit his face!
"There really is something else going on inside!"
Looking down, I saw that the secret book was engraved with dense tadpole characters, as graceful as a dragon, like a swimming dragon, shining with strange light, exuding profound and mysterious truths!
For a moment, Su Changge was ecstatic!
And he also saw the name of this secret book!
On the cover of this secret book, there is nothing but an ordinary book - "Splitting Water Fist"!
But underneath the pages inside, where the page number is marked, is written - "Tai Xuan Dao Zhan Dao Sacred Code"!
"Hahaha!
I really got a big deal this time! "
